high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a woman sitting on the top edge of a brick wall. The wall appears to be quite high, as there is a noticeable drop-off below her. The bricks are laid in a traditional pattern, with some variation in size and color, suggesting an older structure. The woman is dressed in a dark cardigan or sweater and a light-colored skirt. She has her legs crossed and is leaning slightly forward, resting her hands on the wall for support. Her posture suggests she is relaxed but also aware of the height.
